integrity: A symbolic all-parameter proof and a reproducible finite boundary checker; self-review, independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple complete bipartite host graph with two nontrivial parts; inclusive graph-shortest-path Rips, not continuous metric realization. No equivariance, no general arbitrary bipartite graph extension. Earlier radius-two and line-graph factor results are credited, and unindexed third-power literature is a residual risk.
title: Full graph-metric Rips persistence of subdivided complete bipartite graphs
